spec.description: Loaded vs unloaded class counts over time per service.
spec.title: Class Loading

spec.query:
from(bucket: "bucketakke") |> 
range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> 
filter(fn: (r) => (r.host =~ /$host/ or "$host" == ".*") and (r.service =~ /$service/ or "$service" == ".*")) |> 
filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "jvm.class-loading.loaded") |> 
last()
